agent_explanation: Single body with e=1 and high horizontal speed hits the right arena boundary around step 138. Restitution 1 should preserve speed, but speed grows from ~43.89 to ~49.07 and total energy grows from ~1054 J to ~1294 J with zero controller work. Likely cause: boundary-wall impulse plus positional correction adds energy on a deep high-speed penetration in one dt (2 substeps), e.g. reflecting velocity then pushing the centre out along the normal while retaining/adding the correction to kinetic energy.
